title: SQLite persistence is file-backed but not concurrency-hardened
evidence: app.py:27 sqlite3.connect without check_same_thread/timeout; Flask dev server is single-worker so it works, but a threaded/multi-worker deploy could hit 'database is locked'
suggestion: Add a connection timeout or note the single-worker assumption; not required by the spec

title: ISBN has no uniqueness constraint
evidence: app.py:10-18 SCHEMA declares isbn TEXT with no UNIQUE; duplicate ISBNs are accepted
suggestion: Optional: add a UNIQUE(isbn) constraint if duplicate ISBNs should be rejected. Spec does not require it.

title: test_coverage 0.96 — __main__ run block uncovered
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.96; app.py:174-175 the `if __name__ == '__main__'` app.run() block is not exercised by tests
suggestion: Expected and harmless; the main guard is conventionally excluded from coverage
